name: person-vucetic

slots.subject: A game character: Vučetić, a tall thin fair-skinned Croatian bridge guard in his sixties, standing upright and peering at a small notebook through a brass magnifying glass held in one hand. A long dark green guard's coat with brass buttons and a belt, a stiff round guard's cap with a blank brass badge, a long curled grey moustache, high black boots. A simple picture-book face with small dark dot eyes and a fussy, careful look; dry and a little comic, never mean. Slightly stylised proportions, the head about one sixth of the height; not chibi.
slots.camera: Full-body three-quarter view at eye level, with little perspective.
slots.composition: The figure is centred and fills about nine tenths of the picture's height, with a clear margin on every side.
slots.background: Isolated on plain flat cream paper with no ground, no scenery and no shadow.

notes: Town townsperson: Stražar Vučetić, the bridge guard, asks for the drawbridge.
